Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

subsystem must maintain write ahead logging on local nvme drives syncing log buffers every ten milliseconds. network interfaces across all cache server nodes must enable jumbo frames with nine network latency before approving the cluster configuration rollout.", "output": "Remediate severe partition skew across our distributed Redis cache cluster according to the following requirements:

1. Remediate severe partition skew across our distributed Redis cache cluster during peak evening traffic surges.
2. Inspect @routing/ring_router.go in the routing directory and check @storage/vnode_store.rs in the storage engine package.
3. Account for virtual node token distribution across 300 hash slots when cache nodes join or leave the consistent hash ring.
4. Resolve token migration stalls during cluster rebalancing caused by synchronous replication locking vnode partitions during state transfer.
5. Configure the cache replication factor to 3 replicas per partition and implement asynchronous background reconciliation.
6. Update the socket connection timeout to 400 milliseconds and set the maximum replication backlog buffer to 128 MB.
7. Ensure client request hedging queries secondary replicas whenever primary replica response latency exceeds 50 milliseconds.
8. The cluster coordinator must track partition memory usage across 15-second evaluation intervals, isolating unbalanced vnode replicas before cache misses trigger upstream database bottlenecks.
9. Update gossip protocol heartbeats in cluster_state.go to send ping probes every 250 milliseconds and mark lagging storage nodes as degraded when 4 consecutive ping attempts fail.
10. Enforce volatile-lru cache eviction policies to prevent unexpired customer session keys from being purged during memory spikes.
11. Review memory_manager.cpp to verify that jemalloc background threads purge dirty pages when heap fragmentation exceeds 20%.
12. Direct site reliability engineers to monitor p99 cache lookup latencies on the primary Grafana dashboard, keeping overall response times under 15 milliseconds during cluster rebalancing.
13. If a secondary replica becomes unresponsive for more than 60 seconds, the cluster manager must trigger automatic node eviction and redistribute virtual hash tokens to standby compute instances.
14. Require the backup replication coordinator in snapshot_coordinator.py to capture incremental RDB snapshots every 6 hours, saving compressed binary dumps to encrypted object storage.
15. Maintain write ahead logging on local NVMe drives syncing log buffers every 10 milliseconds to guarantee zero data loss during unplanned hardware faults.
16. Enable jumbo frames with 9000-byte maximum transmission units on all cache server node network interfaces to eliminate TCP packet fragmentation under high throughput workloads.
17. Enforce Transport Layer Security version 1.3 with mutual client certificate validation across all inter-node replication channels per security operations mandates.
18. Prohibit cluster operators from restarting primary nodes without initiating manual graceful connection handoffs to secondary instances.
19. The distributed systems infrastructure team requires automated benchmark verification demonstrating 20,000 write requests per second under simulated network latency before approving the cluster configuration rollout."}]
